item.storymod.dawn_star.desc: Warm, like a morning that almost never came.
item.storymod.keeper_gear.desc: Still warm. Smells of oil and amethyst.
item.storymod.white_pearl.desc: Warm, though it should be cold. Everything feels a little closer around it.
item.storymod.white_pearl.effect: Sneak + use on a block: lift it. Use while holding one: set it down. Use in the air: shadow step.
item.storymod.twilight_amulet.desc: Warm in the dark, cold in the light.
item.storymod.twilight_amulet.effect: Use: shadows hide you and speed you up. Faster in darkness.
item.storymod.keeper_wrench.effect: Use with a damaged item in the other hand: repairs it for a copper ingot. Held: faster digging.
item.storymod.order_medallion.desc: A sign of the Order of Zenith.
item.storymod.clockwork_heart.desc: Still ticking. It remembers how to hurry.
item.storymod.zenith_shard.desc: Glows on its own, like stone above the clouds.
item.storymod.white_greatsword.desc: Two-handed, yet light as a shadow in the right hand.
item.storymod.white_greatsword.effect: In its owner's hand: swings like a one-handed blade. Use: step behind the target (up to 16 blocks) and strike.
item.storymod.keeper_hammer.effect: In its owner's hand: blows stun. Use: slam the ground, hurting and throwing back everything around.
item.storymod.berserker_charm.effect: Below a third of health: strength.
item.storymod.white_pearl.effect2: Carried or worn: sometimes slips away from arrows, ender pearls do not hurt, faster in darkness.
item.storymod.role_weapon.foreign: Heavy and dull in anyone else's hands.
item.storymod.order_blade.desc: The mark of the Order of Zenith on the guard.
item.storymod.end_mark.desc: Cold as the void between stars.
item.storymod.end_mark.minus: - In water and rain: weakness and slowness.
item.storymod.copper_oath.desc: An oath struck into copper. It does not come off easily.
item.storymod.bound: Bound to its owner: cannot be thrown away or lost on death.
item.storymod.star_shard.desc: A thin glowing thread runs through it.
item.storymod.star_core.desc: Warm, and slowly beating, like something asleep.
item.storymod.star_eyepiece.desc: Use: where and when the next star falls.
item.storymod.quiet_tea.desc: Honey, lily and berries. Calms the silence for a couple of days.
item.storymod.quiet_tincture.desc: Bitter. Drives the silence out for good.
item.storymod.ilva_thread.desc: Warm and alive. Pulls its owner out of a deadly blow (once every 4 minutes).
item.storymod.loom_shuttle.desc: Use on a hot fallen star: cools it and pulls out a shard.
item.storymod.comet_tail.desc: A pale feather, warm to the touch.
item.storymod.comet_tail.effect: At night in the Overworld: Speed II.
item.storymod.seam_needle.desc: Thin as a ray of light, and as strong.
item.storymod.seam_needle.effect: Below a quarter of health: Resistance II.
item.storymod.outpost_sign.desc: A circle cut by a line. One of seven.
item.storymod.sayr_hourglass.desc: The last sand of the Noon Outpost.
item.storymod.sayr_hourglass.effect: By day in the Overworld: Haste II.
item.storymod.tina_shell.desc: Hold it to your ear and someone laughs.
item.storymod.tina_shell.effect: Underwater: Conduit Power. Drowns out the silence.
item.storymod.hald_tongue.desc: A bell's clapper. Made of ice, yet it never melts.
item.storymod.seina_petal.desc: From the tree with no name.
item.storymod.seina_petal.effect: Below half health, out of combat: Regeneration.
item.storymod.moss_spore.desc: The silence cannot eat it, nor can hunger.
item.storymod.varg_compass.desc: Points home, whatever one calls home.
item.storymod.veira_mirror.desc: Only you in it. Only you now.
item.storymod.seven_banner.desc: Seven lights around the edge and one in the middle.
item.storymod.seven_banner.effect: Always: Hero of the Village II.
